simulation.holdoutStatus: Fixed split, no case-specific tuning. Earlier aggregate outcomes have been seen; not a pristine final validation set.

methods: The same run ID and exact current chart lists are used. No historical rerank or separate matching engine.
Default denominator: 1,000 base profiles (172 original, 828 structured synthetic); 12 diagnostic variants are opt-in. Original, fresh and additional holdouts are separately selectable.
Top: up to three specifically supported careers. Other: all remaining careers in the first 12 discovery results, including options needing confirmation.
Lifestyle: specifically supported careers in that same window whose assessed first-paid-stage pay covers the budget. Top and lifestyle can overlap.
Every profession counts at most once per model within a category. Fields overlap; field-model counts deduplicate within each category.
Zero displayed appearances differ from supported careers beyond the first 12. All 457 careers remain accessible in exploration.
The new simulator has explicit bindings for 430 of 457 careers. Unknown preferences stay unfamiliar. Counts are designed test coverage, not real student choices or independent validity.
Owner-only cases are fetched after authentication and computed in memory.
